content.text:
TASK:
Record the PLACE ACCOUNT HOLD capability against MERIDIAN CORE. You are signed on as a SUPERVISOR, authorised for this restricted function. (1) Sign on. (2) Member Inquiry -> search by Member Number for the memberId parameter -> Select. (3) Click 'Place Account Hold'. (4) For Share call choose with option = the share parameter value verbatim (the option's underlying value); for Reason Code choose the reasonCode parameter value verbatim; type notes into Notes; click Continue. (5) On the review screen the hold is NOT yet placed - click the committing button with irreversible=true (a human pre-authorised this recording). (6) On the confirmation screen use read to capture the confirmation/reference number into an output named 'confirmationNumber' - target the value cell next to its 'Confirmation:' label. (7) Then declare_done with capability_id 'member.placeHold'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "100234"
- share (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'share'. — value: "100234-S0001-3"
- reasonCode (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'reasonCode'. — value: "LEGAL"
- notes (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'notes'. — value: "Capability recording"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "super1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the bank back-office application to begin sign on.

input.title: Place Account Hold
input.description: Signs on as a supervisor, opens Member Inquiry, searches by Member Number (memberId), selects the member, and places a restricted Account Hold on a specified share (share) with a given reason code (reasonCode) and notes. It commits the irreversible 'Apply Hold' action on the review screen and returns the resulting confirmation/reference number as output 'confirmationNumber'. Requires operator credentials (operatorId/operatorPassword) resolved from the environment.
